content.study:
Section 43L — Power to make regulations by Council

Section 43L empowers the Arbitration Council of India, in consultation with the Central Government, to make regulations consistent with the Act and rules for discharge of its functions and duties.

The provision belongs to the Arbitration Council of India framework and must be read with applicable regulations and commencement notifications.
